verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs explicitly describe first-class monorepo support with 'filtering to run tasks on just the projects you touched,' and community testimonials corroborate strong built-in monorepo/workspace usage. missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of the --filter flag syntax and a documented 'affected by change' detection mechanism (e.g. --filter=...[origin/main]) with independent hands-on confirmation.
